cohort: Nulliparous women with uncomplicated singleton pregnancy at 40° to 41(6) weeks in Queensland, Australia
finding: Induction of labor in nulliparous women with uncomplicated singleton pregnancy at 40° to 41(6) weeks was associated with a significantly higher cesarean section rate compared to spontaneous labor.
mod_finding: Induction of labor in nulliparous women with uncomplicated singleton pregnancy at 40 to 41 weeks gestation was associated with a significantly higher incidence of cesarean section compared to spontaneous labor.
